organization.name: Combine Foundation
organization.motto: A vision to combine efforts, uplift communities, and inspire hope
organization.legalStatus: Non-Profit Organization (NPO) registered under Section 42 of the Companies Act 2017 (registered in 2023 with SECP); Tax-exempt organization and the social impact arm of Combine Group
organization.foundedFocus: Registered in 2023 as the social impact arm of Combine Group to uplift Pakistani youth
organization.about: Combine Foundation is a Pakistan-based Non-Profit Organization working to improve access to healthcare awareness and education for underserved communities. As the social impact arm of Combine Group, it creates sustainable change in Pakistan by focusing on education, health awareness, youth empowerment, and community welfare.
organization.mission: Reducing inequality and helping communities grow stronger through education, leadership, and sustainable growth.
organization.vision: Building a stronger Pakistan and the next generation of leaders by empowering 1 million youth through leadership, digital education, sustainability, and community development.

contact.address: B-18 Block 16 Gulshan-e-Iqbal near Expo Centre main University Road Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan

leadership.ceo: Mr. Ashfaq Nathani (Chief Executive Officer & Board Director)

programs.title: Youth Leadership Program (YLP 1.0 & YLP 2.0)
programs.description: A 6-month national leadership development journey empowering university students with practical leadership skills, industry mentorship, and community project execution.

programs.title: CSC Scholarship Program
programs.description: A bi-annual free guidance initiative providing roadmaps, university selection, and application support for students applying for Chinese Government Scholarships.

programs.title: RAISE (Rising Ambitions in Skills & Education)
programs.description: Industry-relevant training connecting learners to practical modules in Python with AI, Web Development, Basic Computer Skills, Quantitative Finance, and Meta Ads.

programs.title: Free IT & Technical Courses
programs.description: In-demand skill training courses structured with up to 95% scholarships for passionate students.

programs.title: Ramzan Ration Distribution
programs.description: An annual Ramadan humanitarian project delivering food ration packages to deserving white-collar families.

programs.title: 'Packet Palto Phir Kharido' Campaign
programs.description: A consumer awareness campaign educating people to read product labels, understand ingredients, and make healthier food choices.

programs.title: One Follower, One Plant (Plantation Drives)
programs.description: Environmental sustainability drives planting trees for supporters to improve air quality and promote ecological responsibility.

programs.title: Healthy Lifestyle Awareness Program
programs.description: Interactive awareness sessions promoting preventive wellness, balanced nutrition, physical activity, and healthy routines.

programs.title: Volunteer Program
programs.description: Opportunities for students to gain hands-on experience across technical, media, graphics, and community service niches. Volunteer applications are submitted on our separate volunteer portal at https://www.combinefoundationportal.com/volunteer/apply.
